name: Fiachra
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Several minor figures in Irish myth bear the name Fiachra, which marks an Irish hero. The best remembered of them is a member of the ill-fated Children of Lir.

attributes.attribute: one doomed child is named Fiachra

okr.objective: Fiachra is an Irish hero also carried by several minor figures, best known as one of the Children of Lir.
key_results: A name held by several minor mythological characters.
The most prominent bearer is one of the doomed Children of Lir.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
